description: Zero-shot lm-evaluation-harness results for Kefir 1 and six small open base models, all re-run by the authors.

source.file: merged.json of the comparison run (authors' workspace, not shipped)

adapter_fix_rerun.note: OpenBookQA, HellaSwag, SWAG, LAMBADA and RACE rerun for both Kefir rows after the adapter switched to separate encoding of context and continuation (2,083 of 319,172 requests change their token split); same harness, settings and T4 FP32; the old adapter reproduced the previous values exactly in the same session

harness.baselines: lm_eval HFLM, dtype float32; TinyBrainBot with trust_remote_code
harness.kefir: custom lm_eval LM class: trailing context whitespace moved to the continuation (as lm-eval does), then context and continuation encoded separately with the pinned tokenizer and concatenated, every continuation token scored, EOD (7992) prepended as document start, right padding, FP32; an input longer than the context keeps its last 2,049 tokens (2,048 input positions)
harness.note: no standard errors were computed (bootstrap_iters=0); Qwen3-0.6B-Base WikiText ran out of T4 memory and is missing

flops_convention: 6 x active non-embedding parameters x training tokens; an estimate, not measured operations

models.label: Kefir 1 Base
models.params_source: results/data/model.json and the weights header: 9,987,992 active minus the tied 8,192 x 256 embedding (2,097,152)
models.tokens_source: results/data/pretrain_summary.json targets_total (target positions including end-of-document padding)
